visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has an uneven distribution of roads and houses, which might confuse players.
The route includes a sudden jump from row 4 to row 27, which could be disorienting for the player.

navigationRisks.description: There are multiple gaps in the road network that might lead to dead ends or inaccessible areas.
The route's sudden change from row 4 to row 27 could cause navigation issues for players who rely on a linear path.
